bootstrap_split.rule: first 30% of entity timeline by nominal time, causal thresholds only from bootstrap

canonical_entity.note: Prefer alloc instances / long-lived collections; do not double-count parent and child usage. Cell is one of the eight May 2019 Borg cells.

corpus_specific_changes_not_changing_rqs.change: entity is Borg collection_id+instance_index instead of Materna VM
corpus_specific_changes_not_changing_rqs.why_rq_unchanged: RQs concern profile maintenance/cadence/cost, not VM branding

corpus_specific_changes_not_changing_rqs.change: utilization is request-normalized NCU/RAM instead of provisioned %
corpus_specific_changes_not_changing_rqs.why_rq_unchanged: Still a paired two-resource utilization series with identical window/truth/accounting semantics; unit difference is declared

corpus_specific_changes_not_changing_rqs.change: multi-cell export may be one cell first for cost control
corpus_specific_changes_not_changing_rqs.why_rq_unchanged: Cell choice is a corpus stratum, not a method change

duplicate_missing_handling.duplicates: dedupe by (entity, bucket_start); keep deterministic max end_time then first row

nominal_cadence.binning_rule: Map each usage record to nominal five-minute grid by floor(start_time) to 300s buckets in trace-relative microseconds; never upsample or invent missing buckets
nominal_cadence.source: instance_usage windows typically 300s; may be shorter at lifetime edges

units_and_normalization.profile_utilization_definition: request_normalized_utilization = average_usage / request when request>0 for that resource; else exclude sample as missing
units_and_normalization.scientific_meaning_transfer: Profiles remain trailing-window mean/p95 and class gates on a paired two-resource utilization series evaluated hourly against forward (t,t+24h] truth. Units are request-normalized Borg usage, not Materna provisioned-capacity percentages. RQs about maintenance, cadence, rewrite cost, and robustness are unchanged; cross-corpus claims must state the unit adaptation.

inherited_from_v3_unchanged.observation_window: (t-24h,t], >=200/288 paired finite resource slots where refresh eligibility applies
